_README: Cost = recorded tokens x these rates. The TOKENS are exact (read from Claude Code's own session transcripts). The COST is an ESTIMATE at the rates below. Edit these to match what you actually pay, then re-run token_cost_history.py. Rates are US dollars per MILLION tokens.
_defaults_note: Defaults are Anthropic's published Opus list prices (input $15, output $75, cache-read = 0.1x input, cache-write-5m = 1.25x input, cache-write-1h = 2x input). If your plan/billing differs, change them.

per_million._use: Reference rates for Claude Code (all Opus). NOTE: if Claude Code is on a Claude subscription (it is — stripe_subscription/claude_pro), this is the list-price VALUE consumed, NOT your bill. Your real Claude Code cost is the subscription fee + any extra-usage overage.

api_models._use: Per-model rates for DIRECT API usage (the Console CSVs). API is genuine pay-as-you-go. Model matched from the CSV's model_version by family. Edit to your actual API prices.

long_context._note: Opus 1M-context requests above the threshold input size may bill at a premium on some plans. Left OFF by default (multiplier 1.0). Set the multiplier to your plan's premium (e.g. 2.0) only if you know it applies.
